visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with glasses in a grey shirt and a woman with glasses in a black shirt sit behind a table filled with various product boxes. They gesture toward the camera with high energy. (2) Close-up shots of individual product packaging for milk tea, soup, and noodles are shown in quick succession. (3) The woman gestures warmly toward the chest area while smiling. (4) A woman in an office setting, sitting in front of a laptop, drinks from a bright yellow mug. (5) Close-up shots of milk tea being stirred in a white mug with a spoon, followed by shots of the woman tasting it and reacting with a pleasant facial expression. (6) Different tea sachets are poured into a yellow pot, and the man is seen smelling and tasting the drink from a glass. (7) A woman dressed in a green mage cloak with a staff holds a soup box, flanked by two men in medieval-themed costumes. (8) Food pouches are shown being boiled in a white pot alongside green vegetables and mushrooms. (9) Close-up views of various hot soups, including meat and clear broth, being poured into ceramic bowls. (10) Wavy noodles are prepared by pouring a dark sauce over them and mixing; the woman then takes a large bite of the noodles. (11) The man and woman return to the table, waving and pointing to the upper corners of the frame to signify links.

(2) A sharp 'pop' SFX accompanies the visual transition to product boxes. (3) A female voice enters with a warm, friendly tone. Pitch variability is high as she emphasizes 'winter warmth.' (4) Audible liquid pouring SFX and a metallic clink of a spoon hitting a mug occur during the tea demonstration. (5) BGM maintains a consistent 128 BPM tempo. Male voice narrates specific tea flavors with energetic pitch contours. (6) Sizzling and bubbling sounds of water are heard during the soup cooking phase. (7) Narrative continues with descriptions of Bak Kut Teh, using professional broadcasting articulation. (8) A soft slurping SFX is heard as noodles are consumed, mixed with a cheerful vocal reaction. (9) Both male and female voices overlap in a rhythmic sign-off as the BGM volume swells slightly before fading out.
